title: Merge Now, Regret Later: The Hidden Cost of Model Merging Is Adversarial Transferability
abstract: arXiv:2509.23689v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Model Merging (MM) has proven to be an effective alternative to multi-task learning, where several fine-tuned models are merged, without access to the tasks' training data, into one model that retains performance across different tasks. Recent works have explored the security of MM, showing how MM can confer robustness against various adversarial attacks. However, none of them has sufficiently explored its impact on transfer attacks using transferable adversarial examples.   In this work, we study the effect of MM on the transferability of adversarial examples. We perform comprehensive evaluations and statistical analysis consisting of eight MM methods, seven datasets, and six attack methods, sweeping over 336 distinct attack settings. Through it, we first challenge the prevailing notion of MM conferring free adversarial robustness, and show that MM cannot reliably defend against transfer attacks, with over 80% transfer rate. translated_title: 现在合并，日后后悔：模型合并的隐藏代价是对抗性可迁移性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2509.23689v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：模型合并（MM）已被证明是多任务学习的有效替代方案，它能在不访问任务训练数据的情况下，将多个微调模型合并成一个在不同任务上保持性能的模型。近期研究探索了MM的安全性，展示了MM如何赋予模型对各种对抗攻击的鲁棒性。然而，这些研究均未充分探讨其对使用可迁移对抗样本的迁移攻击的影响。在本工作中，我们研究了MM对对抗样本可迁移性的影响。我们进行了全面的评估和统计分析，涵盖八种MM方法、七个数据集和六种攻击方法，横跨336种不同的攻击设置。通过此研究，我们首先挑战了MM提供免费对抗鲁棒性的普遍观念，并表明MM无法可靠地防御迁移攻击，迁移率超过80%。此外，我们进一步发现...
tldr: 本研究揭示了模型合并虽能带来一定对抗鲁棒性，但无法有效防御对抗样本的迁移攻击，其隐藏代价是可迁移性显著增强，导致超过80%的迁移成功率。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that model merging, while offering some adversarial robustness, fails to reliably defend against transfer attacks, with the hidden cost being significantly enhanced adversarial transferability, leading to over 80% transfer success rates.
